risk_note: RV2 (commission and orders modules). Adds read-only ports for trade notifications (orchestrator ruling D10-142 ②: notification may read commission / orders read-only ports, no attribution logic): commission readNotifyBeneficiaries returns the commission_split_amounts rows of the order's current commission_version (user_id, role, amount_fen as stored, bigint, no recomputation, zero shares kept, older versions excluded); orders readNotifyOrderFacts returns nine order fields and readNotifyClaimFacts the claim and its items. SELECT only, every query filtered by app_id, existing commission / orders behaviour unchanged; no caller yet (B1-12q / B1-12r will consume). Two orchestrator mechanical test(spec) commits: the kit takes the test-database factory from the int tests (depcruise rule), and the LONG_TITLE emoji joiners are written as \u200D escapes (guard hidden-unicode); no assertion changes. No money movement, no attribution change.
